title: Titan Pro 15K Rainbow Burst Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Rainbow Burst offers a bright medley of fruit flavours, balancing sweet and tangy notes for a fun, colourful vape experience. The mesh coil ensures even heating for clean, consistent flavour throughout use. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device, giving reliable performance and long-lasting use. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
